data.one_liner: Flutter client for sending messages, media and catalog items via the WhatsApp Business API.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to send text, media, template, flow, catalog and product messages through the WhatsApp Business Cloud API. It also supports business profile updates, resumable uploads and error handling.
use_when: You need to send WhatsApp Business messages directly from a Flutter app
You require web support for WhatsApp messaging
You want built‑in handling for catalog and flow messages
avoid_when: You need a native UI SDK for WhatsApp
You prefer a fully offline messaging solution
You don't have a WhatsApp Business account or API access token
strengths: Covers most WhatsApp Business API features
Web platform support and resumable uploads
Improved performance and detailed error handling
weaknesses: Depends on external WhatsApp Cloud API and access token
No UI widgets, only low‑level API calls
Limited to WhatsApp Business use case
data.setup_notes: Obtain a Meta access token and phone number ID, add internet permission, then instantiate WhatsApp(accessToken, fromNumberId).

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight HTTP client if you prefer manual API calls

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: More feature‑rich HTTP client with interceptors and better error handling
